# Proposal: Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard & Showdown Markdown Artifact Viewer

## Why
When developers and agents work on features in this repository, they need real-time, high-fidelity visibility into what the LLM is doing:
1. **Live LLM Execution Blindspot**: As autonomous agents (Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, etc.) execute multi-step changes, users cannot see the live reasoning (Chain-of-Thought), tool invocations (commands, file operations, subagents), execution durations, or subtask progress without inspecting raw CLI logs or JSONL files.
2. **Broken Markdown Artifact Backlinks**: In feature companion dashboards (`index.html` and `implementation-progress.html`), the backlink buttons for markdown artifacts (`proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`, `specs/`) fail when clicked in `localhost:3000`. The dev server returns 404 because the files reside in `openspec/changes/<feature>/`, and standard browsers do not format `.md` files nicely (often downloading them as `application/octet-stream`).
3. **Repository-Specific Need**: For this repo's development flow, having an integrated, Showdown-powered in-browser markdown viewer and a Datastar live tracking dashboard transforms the local dev server (`localhost:3000`) into a living command center that seamlessly tracks LLM activity and enables instant, beautiful inspection of OpenSpec artifacts.

## What Changes
1. **Showdown In-Browser Markdown Viewer & Dev Server Resolution**:
   - Upgrade `serve-report.mjs` to recognize `.md` files (`text/markdown; charset=utf-8`) and auto-resolve artifact requests (`/proposal.md`, `/design.md`, `/tasks.md`, `/specs/...`) against the active OpenSpec change directory.
   - Upgrade feature companion headers in `index.html` and `implementation-progress.html` with an interactive Showdown Markdown Viewer modal (`<dialog id="markdown-viewer-modal">`). Clicking any artifact button immediately renders publication-grade GitHub Flavored Markdown with syntax highlighting, task checkboxes, tables, and document switcher tabs without navigating away or downloading raw files.
   - Provide direct browser preview fallback so loading `.md` URLs directly renders a clean Showdown view.
2. **Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard**:
   - Provide a real-time reactive dashboard using `@starfederation/datastar` and SSE (`/__datastar_stream__`).
   - Live Agent Thought Stream (`#agent-thought-stream`): Displays streaming Chain-of-Thought / reasoning text in real-time.
   - Live Tool Invocations Feed (`#tool-call-feed`): Renders tool calls (`read_file`, `run_command`, `write_file`, etc.) with running spinners, duration badges, arguments, and collapsible DaisyUI terminal drawers (`mockup-code`).
   - Live Task Progress Matrix (`#task-matrix`): Displays phases and tasks from `tasks.md`, morphing task cards in place upon status updates (`pending`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`).
   - Journey Phase Stepper (`#journey-stepper`): Publication-standard horizontal stepper showing current phase (`Brainstorming`, `Planning`, `Implementing`, `Verifying`, `Shipped`).
   - Live Metrics & Telemetry Controller: Interactive controls (Simulate Burst, Step, Play/Pause, Reset) and an active dev server bridge (`telemetry-streamer.mjs`) enabling live push from real agent executions.

# Technical Design: Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard & Showdown Markdown Artifact Viewer

## Architecture Overview
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph Browser["Browser Client (localhost:3000)"]
        Navbar["Sticky DaisyUI Navbar"]
        
        subgraph MarkdownViewer["Showdown Markdown Artifact Viewer"]
            ArtifactBtns["Backlink Buttons\n(proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md, specs/)"]
            Modal["DaisyUI Modal (#markdown-viewer-modal)"]
            ShowdownEngine["Showdown.js GFM Converter"]
            DocTabs["Document Switcher Tabs & Copy Button"]
            ArtifactBtns --> Modal
            Modal --> ShowdownEngine
            ShowdownEngine --> DocTabs
        end

        subgraph DatastarDashboard["Datastar.js Reactive Telemetry Dashboard"]
            DSStream["data-on-load=@get('/__datastar_stream__')"]
            CoTFeed["Agent Thought Stream (#agent-thought-stream)"]
            ToolFeed["Tool Invocations Feed (#tool-call-feed)"]
            TaskCards["Task Checklist (#task-1.1, #task-1.2)"]
            Stepper["Journey Stepper (#journey-stepper)"]
            MetricsGauges["Progress Gauges & Counters"]
            
            DSStream --> CoTFeed
            DSStream --> ToolFeed
            DSStream --> TaskCards
            DSStream --> Stepper
            DSStream --> MetricsGauges
        end
    end

    subgraph DevServer["Live Dev Server (serve-report.mjs)"]
        SSEEndpoint["/__datastar_stream__ (GET & POST)"]
        ActiveResolver["Active Change Artifact Resolver\n(openspec/changes/<active>/)"]
        MimeHandler["MIME Handler (.md -> text/markdown)"]
        LiveReload["/__live_reload__"]
    end

    subgraph LLMAgent["LLM Agent Runtimes & Streamers"]
        AGY["Google Antigravity / Agent Runtimes"]
        Transcript["transcript.jsonl / Live Steps"]
        TelemetryBridge["telemetry-streamer.mjs / DatastarBridge"]
        AGY --> Transcript
        Transcript --> TelemetryBridge
        TelemetryBridge -->|POST SSE Events| SSEEndpoint
    end

    SSEEndpoint --> DSStream
    Modal -->|Fetch .md / Fallback cache| ActiveResolver
    ActiveResolver --> MimeHandler
```

## Detailed Component Specifications

### 1. Showdown In-Browser Markdown Viewer
1. **Dev Server Artifact Routing (`serve-report.mjs`)**:
   - Detects requests for `.md` files or paths like `/proposal.md`, `/design.md`, `/tasks.md`, `/specs/...`.
   - Resolves from repo root first; if not found, locates the active change directory in `openspec/changes/` and serves the file with `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.
   - Supports HTML direct preview fallback if accessed directly in the browser address bar with `Accept: text/html` or query `?preview=true`.
2. **In-Page Showdown Modal (`<dialog id="markdown-viewer-modal">`)**:
   - Clean DaisyUI modal dialog with backdrop click dismissal and `Esc` key handling.
   - Header with Lucide icon (`file-text`), document name badge, switcher tabs (`proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`, `specs/`), and copy markdown button.
   - Showdown converter initialized with:
     ```javascript
     const converter = new showdown.Converter({
       tables: true,
       tasklists: true,
       strikethrough: true,
       ghCodeBlocks: true,
       simplifiedAutoLink: true,
       openLinksInNewWindow: true
     });
     ```
   - Renders into DaisyUI `prose prose-sm sm:prose max-w-none text-base-content`.
   - Embedded cache containing current artifacts so the viewer works instantly even offline or in standalone files.

### 2. Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard
1. **Real-Time SSE Streaming Pipeline**:
   - Uses `@starfederation/datastar@1.0.0-beta.9` loaded via addon CDN.
   - Automatically connects to dev server `/__datastar_stream__` via Datastar SSE attributes or native EventSource bridge.
2. **Agent Thought Stream (`#agent-thought-stream`)**:
   - Displays real-time reasoning / Chain-of-Thought logs in expandable, distinct chat bubbles (`chat chat-start`).
   - Timestamps and token counters.
3. **Live Tool Invocations Feed (`#tool-call-feed`)**:
   - Displays real-time cards for executed tools (`read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `run_command`, `invoke_subagent`).
   - Category icons (`terminal`, `file-code`, `globe`, `users`).
   - Real-time running spinner during execution; duration badge (`120ms`) upon completion.
   - Collapsible DaisyUI terminal drawer (`mockup-code`) with stdout lines.
4. **Task Matrix & Stepper**:
   - Synchronized with `tasks.md`.
   - Surgical DOM morphing: updating task `#task-1.1` from `pending` to `running` to `completed` replaces only `#task-1.1` without reloading the page or losing scroll position.
5. **Interactive Telemetry Controller & CLI Streamer**:
   - On-screen controls to simulate live LLM steps (Burst mode, Step mode, Reset) for immediate demonstration on `localhost:3000`.
   - Streamer script (`skills/html-report/scripts/telemetry-streamer.mjs`) that can tail live agent logs or push synthetic events via `POST /__datastar_stream__`.

# Capability Delta: Live LLM Tracking Dashboard & Showdown Artifact Viewer

## ADDED REQUIREMENTS

### Requirement: Dev Server Markdown Resolution & MIME Handling
The dev server (`serve-report.mjs`) MUST support `text/markdown; charset=utf-8` and automatically resolve markdown artifact links (`/proposal.md`, `/design.md`, `/tasks.md`, `/specs/...`) against the active OpenSpec change directory if they do not exist at root.

#### Scenario: Requesting Artifact Markdown File
- **GIVEN** a dev server running against `implementation-progress.html` with an active change in `openspec/changes/<feature-name>/`
- **WHEN** a client makes an HTTP GET request to `/proposal.md`
- **THEN** the server MUST resolve the file from `openspec/changes/<feature-name>/proposal.md` and respond with status 200 and `Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8`.

---

### Requirement: Showdown In-Browser Markdown Artifact Viewer
The standard report MUST provide an interactive Showdown-powered modal viewer allowing users to click `.md` artifact buttons and view formatted GitHub Flavored Markdown with syntax highlighting and task checklists without leaving the page or downloading raw files.

#### Scenario: Clicking Markdown Artifact Link
- **GIVEN** a user viewing the journey dashboard in the browser
- **WHEN** the user clicks any artifact button (`proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`, or `specs/`)
- **THEN** the report MUST open `<dialog id="markdown-viewer-modal">` and render the document's content using Showdown with GFM tables, tasklists, and code blocks.

#### Scenario: Switching Between Artifact Tabs
- **GIVEN** the markdown viewer modal is open
- **WHEN** the user clicks another tab in the modal header (e.g. `design.md` or `tasks.md`)
- **THEN** the viewer MUST seamlessly switch content and render the selected artifact.

---

### Requirement: Datastar Live LLM Tracking Dashboard
The report MUST provide real-time hypermedia tracking components powered by Datastar.js and SSE (`/__datastar_stream__`) displaying LLM thoughts, tool calls, and task progress.

#### Scenario: Live Chain-of-Thought Stream
- **GIVEN** an active Datastar stream connection
- **WHEN** an agent emits a thought delta event
- **THEN** Datastar MUST append or morph the thought into `#agent-thought-stream` without page reload.

#### Scenario: Live Tool Invocation & Terminal Output
- **GIVEN** an active Datastar stream connection
- **WHEN** a tool call event is received
- **THEN** Datastar MUST prepend a tool invocation card to `#tool-call-feed` displaying tool name, arguments, status indicator, and collapsible terminal output drawer.

#### Scenario: Real-Time Task Card Morphing
- **GIVEN** a task item `#task-${id}` in the dashboard
- **WHEN** the server broadcasts a `datastar-fragment` with `selector: #task-${id}` and updated status
- **THEN** Datastar MUST morph the task card in-place, updating the status badge, checkbox, and completion state.
